title: 星展CEO陈淑珊：三线变零点五线，流程重做后效率能翻几倍？
speaker: Tan Su Shan

segments.en: And you're one of the first things I think to actually come up with returns from AI.
segments.zh: 你们是最早从AI中获得回报的公司之一。

segments.en: I mean you had a number here about $1 billion in AI economic value for last year.
segments.zh: 你提到去年AI经济价值有10亿美元。

segments.en: Do you have targets set for this year or maybe we want to beat last year's token and so we have our own internal targets.
segments.zh: 今年有设定目标吗？或许想超越去年的代币量，我们内部有自己的目标。

segments.en: Even what you mentioned was what we call the AI ML the traditional classic AI if you will.
segments.zh: 你提到的其实是我们所说的传统经典AI。

segments.en: What we're now attempting to measure is how the generative and agent AI now will increase our efficacy increase our customer journey and really rethinking our workflows.
segments.zh: 我们现在试图衡量的是生成式和代理式AI如何提升效率、改善客户旅程，并真正重新思考工作流程。

segments.en: Now that's a bit harder because when you have to rethink your workflows because really for agent work to make sense.
segments.zh: 这有点难，因为要重新思考工作流程，代理工作才有意义。

segments.en: You can't be using your old workflows of line one line two line three to to work anymore.
segments.zh: 不能再用一线、二线、三线的旧流程来工作了。

segments.en: In fact, why can't line three be line zero point five?
segments.zh: 事实上，为什么三线不能变成零点五线呢？

segments.en: And that's one I've challenged the team to rethink the entire workflows.
segments.zh: 我挑战团队重新思考整个工作流程。

segments.en: And that you can't boil the ocean you've got to focus on what's going to matter.
segments.zh: 不能试图煮沸海洋，必须聚焦于真正重要的事。

segments.en: And so we've chosen 12 big workflows to change. We call them operating model transformations.
segments.zh: 因此我们选择了12个大型工作流程进行变革，称之为运营模式转型。

segments.en: OMTs for short and that's where we want to measure for example completely different outcomes you know FTE saves you know a capacity realization because you know I guess what we're growing.
segments.zh: 简称OMT，我们想以此衡量完全不同的成果，比如节省全职人力、实现产能，因为我们正在增长。

segments.en: And if you want to grow without increasing your head count then realizing capacity through the use of agents through the use of genitive AI is the answer.
segments.zh: 如果想在不增加人手的情况下增长，那么通过智能体和生成式AI释放产能就是答案。
